pages.title: Moose
pages.text: The moose ($(o)Alces alces$()), known as the elk in Europe, is the largest living deer, inhabiting the boreal and mixed forests of North America, Europe and Asia.$(br2)Bulls grow broad, palmate antlers each year and shed them after the autumn rut.$(br2)Moose are browsers that feed on twigs, leaves and bark, and in summer they often wade into lakes and rivers to eat aquatic plants.
